gap: No result ChatGPT got states a measured figure from a named lab. Notebookcheck measured the Samsung Galaxy Tab Active5 Pro at 768 cd/m² maximum brightness, below the 800–1,000+ nits ChatGPT itself recommends for outdoor use, and at 22 h 36 min of Wi-Fi browsing. It measured the Dell Latitude 7030 Rugged Extreme at 1,236 cd/m² but only 6 h 07 min of browsing on its 36 Wh battery, and the original Toughbook G2 at 1,108.5 cd/m² and 11 h 10 min. RuggedPCReview measured the Dell Pro Rugged 12 at 1,320 nits and 13 h 51 min in PCMark 10.
standout_why: I compared against both cited pages: Panasonic's US G2 page (connect.na.panasonic.com) and its Swiss/EU G2 page (eu.connect.panasonic.com/ch/en). Both give only Panasonic's own ratings: 'up to 1,000 nits' and 11 or 15 h MobileMark 25. The EU page says the ruggedness tests were run by an unnamed 'independent third party lab' but quotes no independent measurement of brightness, battery life or weight. The other results are Panasonic spec PDFs and press pages, Dell's and Getac's store pages, and two listicles. The rottenwifi listicle returned HTTP 502, so I could not check it. None of the pages I could open gives a reviewer-measured nit or runtime figure for any candidate. None compares the candidates on the same test.
decides: It weakens ChatGPT's 'best value for Android' pick for bright outdoor work. Notebookcheck's 768 cd/m² for the Tab Active5 Pro misses ChatGPT's own 800–1,000+ nit guideline, while every Windows unit measured lands at 1,100–1,320 nits. On the other hand, the Tab Active5 Pro's 22.6 h of browsing is the only clear full-shift result without swapping a battery. For Windows, RuggedPCReview's 13 h 51 min PCMark 10 result and 1,320 nits support the Dell Pro Rugged 12 over the older Latitude 7030. Notebookcheck measured just over 6 h on the Latitude 7030's 36 Wh battery and calls its short runtime a drawback. One caveat: the Toughbook G2 figures come from the 2021 first-generation unit (Core i5-10310U, 68 Wh). I found no measurement of the Mk3 that ChatGPT showed.
